summary.text: Sandra Feist is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 39B, first elected in 2020.

Her official House page lists committee assignments including Public Safety Finance and Policy, Veterans and Military Affairs Division, and Judiciary Finance and Civil Law, and gives her occupation as attorney, with a B.A. from the University of Wisconsin and a J.D. from William Mitchell College of Law.

sources.title: Rep. Sandra Feist (39B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
